meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Use Orca orchestration for structured multi-agent coordination: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply flows, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, or decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` instead for full ownership handoffs, including requests phrased as "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", or "another worktree" when the user did not explicitly ask to supervise, monitor, wait for results, or coordinate a DAG. Use `orca-cli` for ordinary terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, reading or waiting on terminals, and automation of the browser embedded inside Orca. Use Computer Use for browser windows, webviews, Orca app UI, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser.

copy.tagline: 协调多个智能体分工协作完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把一个大任务拆成多个助手并行处理并汇总结果。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate multiple AI agents to split and execute complex tasks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple AI assistants and need structured task coordination.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要 Claude 同时协调多个代理任务时，它会借助 Orca 编排工具来管理。它会先获取当前版本的完整操作指南，再按指南分发任务、等待结果、处理依赖等，而不是凭空猜测命令。
howto.when: 当用户要求多代理协调，如任务分发、等待结果、按依赖编排流程时触发；若只是完整所有权交接或普通终端操作，则改用 orca-cli，不触发本技能。

say.text: 把任务拆成两部分，让两个代理并行做，最后汇总结果。
say.note: 会用 Orca 编排来分配并等待结果。

say.text: 让代理 A 完成后，再启动代理 B，最后把结论给我。
say.note: 会生成一个按步骤依赖的任务流。

say.text: 根据中间结果做一个决策门，决定下一步走哪条分支。
say.note: 会按 Orca 的决策门机制决定分支。

howto.what_en: When you ask Claude to coordinate multiple agents, it uses Orca orchestration: it fetches the version-matched guide, then follows it to dispatch tasks, wait for results, and handle dependencies.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests for structured multi-agent coordination: task dispatch, worker_done waits, or DAG workflows. Handoffs or terminal control use orca-cli instead.

say_en.text: Split this into two subtasks for different agents in parallel, then summarize.
say_en.note: Claude uses Orca to dispatch and await results.

say_en.text: Have agent A notify agent B after finishing, then give me the conclusion.
Create a decision gate to choose the next branch based on intermediate results.
say_en.note: Claude applies the Orca decision-gate mechanism.
